answer: One reef plot off an island, one identity, a 70-credit bond on a marble marker. The island tide table randomly reassigns reef plots each epoch; the owner files a signed survey of the new plot, serial, tide reading; a wrong-plot survey or reused marble serial burns the bond. Fakes need a 35-credit visit per epoch; 1,000 fakes lock 70,000, pay 35,000; honest agents pay 70 once, 35 per epoch, and recover it. A rented-survey ring dies on one serial.
